text:
maria: ci-bench alert: PR #5112 exceeded perf threshold on microbench 'kv_lookup_small' +12.8% vs base. See https://ci.redwood/5112/results. Logs attached.

perf-bot: perf-bot: Perf run 5112: diff +12.8% (threshold 5%). Regression flagged. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/5112/artifacts

alex: On it. Can someone grab the flamegraphs? suspect kernel-selection tweak from nate's commit 5a3f7e

sam: I pulled the branch locally. Re-ran microbench with --profile. Results: baseline 1.2ms -> branch 1.36ms. Flame: higher L2 miss in matmul_kernel_v2. Pasted snippet:
```
matmul_kernel_v2: cpu 42% -> 58% time
kv_cache_lookup: small increase
```

kai: Noted. I also saw increased cache churn when sequence length spikes. Might be our batching heuristic skipping cache reuse path for short sequences due to new bucket logic.

nate: I did change kernel selector to prefer v2 for small batch sizes to reduce startup overhead. Didn't expect matmul to regress. My PR: https://git/redwood/pull/5099

maria: Ok can we bisect quickly? Alex can you run `git bisect` between main@{yesterday} and <branch>?

alex: Running now. If bisect points to my earlier optimizer pass, I'll open a revert.

ci-bot: deploybot: Starting automated bisect job for PR 5112...

alex: Bisect complete: culprit commit is nate@5a3f7e (kernel selector change).

nate: I can push a tweak to selector weights. test suggestion: fallback to v1 when seq_len>128 and batch_size<=4.

sam: Quick patch applied locally reduces regression to +1.1%. Pushed proof-of-concept diff:
```
if seq_len>128 and batch_size<=4:
    prefer_kernel('v1')
```

maria: @nate can you ship a proper fix PR? If not, we should revert to unblock release.

nate: I'll open PR in 20m. If tests fail, revert sounds fine.

perf-bot: perf-bot: New microbench after Alex revert candidate shows -0.2% diff. CI green for perf thresholds :white_check_mark:

alex: Opened revert PR #5120. Linking: https://git/redwood/pull/5120

maria: Great. Marking this as rollout blocker for today's release. @eng-runtime please prioritize.

kai: :thumbsup: I'll add a unit test to cover the batch selection matrix to catch this in future.

sam: Also adding a small perf unit test that exercises seq_len 128/256 with B=1..4.

maria: Thanks all — please update thread when PR merges.
